## Description

In dashboard_model.py, list work-items with --full to read relationships.depends_on. TaskRow gains waits_on (slugs of dependencies that are not done, in dependency order) and running_since (recorded_at of the latest assignment for the work-item, only while it is in progress; decision running-time-source).

payload.title: Carry waits-on and running-since on task rows
